method: Read matching, profile schema, builder UI and all nine deferred tool profiles.
Ran 25 existing system-builder unit tests, all passed.
Parsed built builder data: 80 profiles, 93 workflows, 89 total catalog tools.
Ran synthetic real-catalog and serialization/storage reproductions in memory only.
Checked official CodeQL, Semgrep, SonarQube and Coverity references; PVS detailed pages could not be retrieved.
No browser interaction in this lane; agent07's live observations are attributed and corroborated with code/pure functions, not claimed as independent clicks.

findings.title: A valid imported system can grow into saved and exported data that cannot be restored
findings.reader_task: Continue editing an imported system and rely on browser saving or export for recovery.
findings.evidence: parseProfile enforces 1 MB, including storage restore. serializeProfile validates structure but not bytes, and saveProfile stores its output without a size check. A schema-valid 903365-byte imported system becomes 1203365 bytes after filling existing allowed notes fields. Saving returns success. Restore leaves the raw bytes in storage but returns a blank profile plus an error; importing its exported serialization fails the byte cap. The first subsequent edit/autosave of the blank recovery profile overwrites those raw bytes.
findings.preconditions: Rare upper-bound case, requiring an imported system with many long custom language values: 50 components, 100 connections, 80 distinct 200-character language strings per component. Ordinary small systems were not affected by this reproduction. No real browser data was changed.

observed_output.restoredError: The saved system could not be read. Import an exported system file or start a new description.
observed_output.importError: Choose a system file smaller than 1 MB.

findings.impact: An explicitly successful save can later be inaccessible in the UI, and the recovery advice points to an export the same parser rejects. Reload alone does not delete bytes; subsequent editing can replace the retained oversized copy.
findings.confidence: high for pure-function reproduction and UI data-flow mapping; not reproduced through 150 manual field edits.
findings.recommendation: Share the 1 MB byte policy across import, serialization and persistence, report a size-specific failure before overwriting the last restorable save, and preserve/recover an unreadable stored copy before allowing blank-state autosave to replace it. Provide a clear way to reduce or recover over-limit edits. Do not claim a successful save for a payload the restore parser rejects.
acceptance_criteria: Every successfully saved/exported supported profile round-trips through its corresponding restore/import path.
Test exact byte boundary, over-limit schema-valid data, and edit growth from an initially importable profile.
Rejected over-limit saving preserves the previous valid stored value and reports a size-specific message rather than a generic browser-storage failure.
Existing unreadable raw storage is retained for explicit recovery and is not silently replaced by an initial blank-state edit.
Normal v1 files and existing size/shape validation remain compatible.
findings.compatibility: Preserve version 1 structure and existing import limits by default; recovery and persistence behavior change. Any deliberate limit change must be applied consistently and documented.

findings.title: External compatibility verification uses the missing-field action
findings.reader_task: Resolve a known Windows host that is outside a tool workflow's documented examples.
findings.evidence: Real-catalog analysis of a Windows native executable creates a conditional Binwalk match with question {field:'hostPlatform', message:'Verify analysis host OS: Windows is not in this workflow\'s documented examples.'}. ask gives missing and unlisted values the same field/message shape. answerButton always focuses that field; agent07 observed the same message/action in the live UI. Actual click was not performed in this lane.
findings.impact: Accurate uncertainty is shown, but the next action revisits an already answered selector rather than guiding the reader to the evidence needed to resolve it.
findings.confidence: high for source and real-catalog result; medium for assessed usability impact.
findings.recommendation: Keep missing-answer focus actions, but give external-verification questions a distinct action linking the relevant compatibility notes/evidence. Retain conditional status until the reviewed workflow supports the user's actual environment.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown host asks for a host value.
Known unlisted host points to evidence, rather than suggesting that reselecting the same value resolves uncertainty.
Explicit exclusions remain blocked and no manual override invents compatibility.
Existing v1 profile fields remain unchanged.
dependencies: Coordinate with EXP-03 and accessibility review

findings.title: Expand matching through narrow reviewed workflows for existing deferred profiles
findings.reader_task: Find major catalog tools for a system without inheriting unsupported cross-language or cross-edition capabilities.
findings.evidence: All nine catalog profiles without analysisWorkflows are deliberately omitted from builder data. Eight are deferred because their aggregate findings span language-specific analyzers/rules; S-TaLiRo is deferred for unverified current distribution/compatibility. Public CodeQL Python query and extraction documentation provides a concrete starting point for a bounded new workflow, while other products still need rule/edition-specific mapping.
findings.impact: System recommendations omit well-documented catalog options. The omission is honestly disclosed and conservative; it is a coverage opportunity, not a matching-engine defect.
findings.confidence: high for omissions and stated reasons; readiness varies by deferred profile.
findings.recommendation: Start with one CodeQL Python source workflow limited to reviewed injection-risk queries and extraction prerequisites. Next investigate one Semgrep CE rule/language workflow. Add each only after exact inputs, findings, source references, setup, edition and host qualifications are documented. Keep remaining profiles deferred rather than copying aggregate tags.
acceptance_criteria: Each new workflow has a particular language/input path and findings supported by named rule or query evidence.
A positive system, an incomplete system and an incompatible system produce candidate/details/no-match-or-blocked results appropriately.
Free/paid, CE/Pro and Community/Server capabilities remain separate.
New evidence URLs are included in tool sources and covered by existing metadata checks.
Update deferred coverage explanations when a profile gains its first workflow; retain unreviewed modes as omissions.
dependencies: Primary rule/edition review; no tool execution required for documentation-led metadata
findings.compatibility: Additive analysisWorkflows only; saved v1 systems recompute against current catalog without migration.
